prompts.prompt:
[FORMAT]
Vertical 2:3 Pinterest pin composition.

[SUBJECT]
A certification exam study desk scene: a well-worn stack of thick textbooks and exam prep workbooks, scattered highlighters in multiple colors, a small white mechanical countdown timer, and clover-green sticky notes clustered along the edges of the books. No text, no legible writing, no labels anywhere on any object.

[COMPOSITION]
Vertical 2:3 framing. Scene anchored at upper third with the stacked books as the dominant vertical mass. Timer placed at lower-right using rule of thirds. Highlighters fanned loosely at mid-left. Clover-green sticky notes flutter organically from book corners, drawing the eye downward through the frame. Strong top-to-bottom visual hierarchy: books → sticky notes → timer → desk surface. Hand-crafted, lived-in arrangement — not stock-photo symmetry. 35mm natural focal length, f/2.8, shallow depth pulling focus to the book stack while timer softly resolves in background.

[AESTHETIC]
Pinterest-native: warm, studious, quietly aspirational. Cozy study-café mood — dark academia meets clean-girl softness. Worn-in academic warmth, not sterile library. Felt sense of focused effort and quiet ambition.

[LIGHTING]
Soft motivated practical light from a warm desk lamp at 45° camera-left, supplemented by ambient café window light from camera-right. Color temperature 3800K mixed tungsten-and-window warmth. Large softbox diffusion quality on the book surfaces. Gentle highlight rolloff across the paper pages. Dappled broken shadow from foliage visible faintly through the background window. Soft falloff with gradient transition across the desk surface.

[SURFACE & TEXTURE]
Raw oak wood grain desk surface, slightly worn. Matte paper texture on book covers and pages — no legible text visible anywhere. Clover-green sticky notes with subtle paper curl. Soft rubber barrel of highlighters. Ceramic glazed small mug faintly visible at frame edge for warmth. Tactile, lived-in finish throughout.

[COLOR PALETTE]
Muted warm palette: oat and parchment from book pages, clover green as the dominant accent across sticky notes, warm ochre from highlighter barrels, soft warm grey of the timer body, raw oak brown of the desk. Palette cohesion: earthy neutral anchored by a single saturated clover-green accent.

[STYLE REFERENCE]
In the style of Beth Kirby, Brittany Ambridge, and Pia Ulin. Editorial Pinterest aesthetic — warm, intimate, save-worthy.

[QUALITY MARKERS]
Save-worthy, scroll-stopping, magazine-quality, hyper-detailed paper textures, photorealistic grain on wood surface, tactile sticky note curl, soft bokeh on background café environment.

[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words baked into the image,
no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering,
no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects,
no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look,
no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash,
no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions,
no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures,
no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones,
no stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look,
no over-staged feeling, no unrealistically clean environments,
no clipart elements, no obviously composited backgrounds,
no oversaturated colors, no neon, no Instagram-grid square framing,
no horizontal-leaning compositions, no sterile feel,
no legible text anywhere on any surface, no readable letters on book covers, no visible writing on sticky notes, no printed labels on highlighters, no digits on timer face, absolutely zero typography in the scene.

resolution: 2k
